National League club record

Source: R/nationalleague.R
nl_team_info.Rd

Club CMS record: names, logo, website, ticket links.

Usage

nl_team_info(team_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

team_id

SIHF team id (team_id in nl_standings(); the same id as the SIHF family's team_id), e.g. 101144 (EV Zug). A whole number or a digit string.

return_parsed

Logical. TRUE (the default) returns the fastRhockey_data tibble; FALSE returns the raw JSON body as a nested list (api keys already dropped).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (27 columns) with the columns below, or the raw JSON body when return_parsed = FALSE. A valid but empty payload returns a zero-row tibble with these columns.

col_nametypedescription
namecharacterClub name from the club's CMS record
cms_node_idnumericUmbraco CMS node id of the club page (whole number; not a team id).
url_segmentcharacterURL slug of the club page
typecharacterCMS node kind ('Content')
content_typecharacterCMS document type ('club')
urlcharacterSite path of the club page
fields_gridcharacterPage layout blocks; unobserved: null or empty in every sampled row
fields_logo_namecharacterTitle of the club logo media item in the club CMS
fields_logo_idnumericUmbraco CMS media id; not a team id
fields_logo_url_segmentcharacterURL slug; unobserved: null or empty in every sampled row
fields_logo_typecharacterCMS node kind ('Media')
fields_logo_content_typecharacterMedia kind ('Image')
fields_logo_urlcharacterSite path of the image
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_file_srccharacterSite path of the file
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_file_focal_pointcharacterCrop focal point; unobserved: null or empty in every sampled row
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_file_cropscharacterCrop presets; unobserved: null or empty in every sampled row
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_widthintegerImage width, pixels
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_heightintegerImage height, pixels
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_bytesnumericFile size, bytes
fields_logo_fields_umbraco_extensioncharacterFile extension of the club logo media file
team_idnumericSIHF team id (whole number; e.g. 101151 = HC Davos). The same key space as the sihf family's team_id.
fields_websitecharacterClub website URL
fields_ticket_urlcharacterClub ticket-shop URL
fields_game_ticket_urlcharacterPer-game ticket URL template; empty string in the sample
fields_overriden_namecharacterDisplay-name override (sic); empty string in the sample
fields_playerscharacterRoster override; empty string in the sample
fields_api_namecharacterClub key in the app's backend (e.g. 'evz')

Details

robots.txt ruling. www.nationalleague.ch/robots.txt disallows /api. The owner approved building on it on 2026-10-12, for polite, incremental use only: requests are spaced at least one second apart (on every attempt, retries included), and a bulk backfill or a published mirror needs the owner's sign-off first. Crawl incrementally: fetch a finished game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one nl_schedule() call per run, and fetch season tables at most once per game day.

Seasons are END years and go on the wire unchanged. Ids (*_id) are whole-number numeric (a 14-digit game_id exceeds R's 32-bit integer); every other whole-number column is integer. The club backend key the API ships in /teams/{id}/info is dropped before parsing and never returned.

Endpoint: GET https://www.nationalleague.ch/api/teams/{teamId}/info.

Errors

Raises a classed condition (all inherit fastRhockey_error): fastRhockey_no_data for a 404 or an empty answer (no games or rows for that season, team or phase), fastRhockey_asset_fetch for a failed fetch, an error object in a 200, a body without the ids it must carry, or an answer for another season, team, game or player, and fastRhockey_bad_request for a 400/422 or an argument that is not a whole number.

See also

Other National League Functions: nl_current_games(), nl_game_overview(), nl_lineups(), nl_pbp(), nl_player_box(), nl_player_season(), nl_player_stats(), nl_playoffs(), nl_playouts(), nl_schedule(), nl_shots(), nl_standings(), nl_team_player_stats(), nl_team_schedule(), nl_team_stats(), nl_top_scorers()
